claims.text: Employers must provide at least one hour of meal‑time off for regular meals. However, they may give a shorter meal period of not less than twenty minutes if any of the following applies: the work is non‑manual or not physically strenuous; the establishment operates at least sixteen hours a day; there is an actual or impending emergency or urgent work on machinery to avoid serious loss; or the work is needed to prevent loss of perishable goods. When a twenty‑minute meal period is used under one of these cases, the time is counted as compensable work hours.
